This '''language''' was used by the [[Brrbrlpp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esfandia/Legends|Esfandia]]. Prior to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Si]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base]], taught the Brrbrlpp to speak [[trinary]], as it was easier for the base's crew to understand than the Brrbrlpp's native [[Language/Legends|tongue]].<ref name="fh3">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>
